notes.title: 1.8 hotfix #1
notes.content:
Improvements:
Added RV Landmark to Swamp Free Hunt Map 

Minor Swamp Free Hunt Tweaks

Reworked Reloading Mechanic – Allows smoother movement during reloads.


Bug Fixes:
Fixed Navmesh Issue in Sacred Village – The Fleshhound will no longer get stuck in the courtyard.

Fixed Blood Ruby Bug in Sacred Village – Now properly triggers the next stage.

Fixed Decals Potentially Vanishing on AMD Hardware 

Fixed Subtitles Overlapping with Hotbar – Cleaner readability.

Fixed Map Issues in Sacred Village – General polish and adjustments.

Fixed radio music cutting off when moving too far away

Fixed player arms clipping inside the tablet when selecting a weapon



This patch marks another step toward refining the overall experience for both new and returning Hunters. More improvements, polish, and surprises are on the way.

As always, stay safe, and happy hunting!

notes.title: 1.7 hotfix #2
notes.content:
Small Fixes, Future Plans

Hello Hunters!
We hope you’ve been enjoying your beach trips and Yomi adventures. Whether you’ve been with us since the start or just joined us—we thank you! We want to let everyone know that we’ve been listening closely to your feedback, especially from recent reviews and comments.

This patch is a small but important first step in improving the overall experience of A DAY OUT. More specifically, for SOLO players. We’ve got more improvements on the way of course, like quality of life features, gameplay tweaks, and much more. We’ll make sure to share as much as we can as we progress, so keep an eye out for updates / announcements in our discord server!

Once again, thank you for playing, for your feedback, and for sticking with us. It means the world to us!

So as always, stay cool, stay safe, and happy hunting!

notes.title: 1.7 hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hello Hunters! We hope you’ve been enjoying your Day Out in Yomi—we know we have. Huge thanks to everyone who's taken time out of their summer to help take down that fearsome Oni. Don't get too excited though... we're just tuning things up a bit.
 

Back to the beach![carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e45871c38a1b1a0da0ea2ba6d7dbe481f793754a.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/41b3f17977f76bed9a5107c5c3875b9872935279.jpg"][/carousel]
Head to the beach for some fun in the sun. You can access the beach from the FOB.


Map Updates:[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/66e6063c82fe2ea078514f951eafd5c3c1c0bed0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/2caeddef16c010020e6f994605c68d1a08a94e53.jpg"][/carousel]
New voice lines for both the Missing Twins case and the Purgatory case.


Improvements:
Added New Swim Mask to the Beach Map – Now you can dive in with style

Replaced All ‘Ominous’ Voices in Missing Twins and Cult of the Sacred Seraphim

Locked Yokai Traps Until Binding Charm Is Acquired in Land of the Dead

Beach Map Party Mode Activated

Added Failsafe to ‘Sanzu Passage’ in Land of the Dead – Late arrivals no longer get left in the void

New Intro Music for Missing Twins and Cult of the Sacred Seraphim

New ‘Cookout’ Decorations added to the FOB – Fire up the grill, Hunters

 Renamed ‘Chupacabra Canyon’ to American Chupacabra – Now with more yeehaw

New Encounter Music added to the Beach Map – Groove with the crabs

New Radio Added to the Beach – Tune in, chill out

Improved Beach Wardrobe Visibility – Better fits, brighter days

Added HUD Animation 


Bug Fixes:
Fixed Minor Lighting Issue in Land of the Dead case. 

Fixed Xenoraptor’s Acid in the Prologue – No more surprise insta-deaths. 

Fixed Xenoraptor Pathfinding in the Prologue – He’s a bit smarter now… just a bit. 

Fixed Animation Bug when rolling after firing – Only in multiplayer, of course. 

Fixed Issue Preventing Tablet Use on Quads – You can now multitask like a real hunter. 

Fixed walking with emotes still playing

Fixed getting stuck after shooting or reloading with emotes playing

Fixed mouse cursor not auto focusing the game after map loading

Fixed tutorial outro cinematic not capturing mouse

Fixed slime droppings doing repeated damage and quickly killing the player

Fixed an Issue Causing Goob to Steal the Quads in the FOB


As always, thank you for the support. Stay cool, stay safe, and happy hunting!

notes.title: Devlog 1.0 [June 2024]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to our seventh devlog!  It's been quite awhile since the last one. 

Let's take a look at what's coming soon for update 1.0!

That's right.

This next update A Day Out is leaving Early Access. Exciting right?

And don't fret, there's still more content and bug fixes post-release!

[previewyoutube=wUYFQxkNQ9c;full][/previewyoutube]
If you're interested in playtesting all these new features, the 1.0 Beta build is available on the Beta branch of the game. Join our Discord for more information.


Recent Progress
Money System
Money has been added to the game and is earned by completing cases, bounties and finding it in the field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/110386b5cbfa5402a3e2ae84e4df58667f7b0863.png
The tablet has been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/97c7fc3d9bddcd8cae3fa79d830f114d134ceca7.png
The FOB PC has also been updated.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7a8c028eb4905f3437b1fbe3dff3e07fcb0a22de.png
Collectible cash has been added.

Bounties
Bounty contracts have been added to the FOB PC and can be taken on to earn money between cases.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/5b9bec1f7eb58df900fe1da147908c0183c76372.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/25ff31572bbcae5edce9ace86121ebe2aef1e1b3.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/291602f5a11cf4bfc1d54f443d57a1f1306fd4da.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7f2ac0d904448918d915c61f7672fec90321ef7e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3020f97eed689843ea8817d0aac2813c4c58eb20.jpg
Bounties can be found in the bounties folder on the FOB PC. 
They show up randomly and can be replayed as many times as you want.


You're probably wondering what all this new money is good for.


(It's this)
Loadout Whiteboard
A new whiteboard has been added to The FOB. You can use it to organize your loadout for cases and bounties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/331b2b684addf72036c132a8423790018e770fa5.png
The whiteboard lists all your chosen items and remaining money.
Only the host can choose the loadout.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/9a63d4d23671ac01b20637bc09d70a0b3b30716d.jpg
Your loadout can be found inside the tan military crates at the start of the case.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/8158cb995b0e2c073a4a02a95fee85f857e3a9da.png
At the end of a case or bounty, all players will be rewarded and the host will have their loadout refunded.
However if you lose or abort, your loadout costs won't be covered.

Gadgets
Gadgets are a new class of item that can be used to hunt, lure and kill monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e0d90b3acc173850939eb0ea247822444cb98bdf.jpg
Ground Sensors are used to detect sources of movement and display them on the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/005083c49faea7415d709a9730731cf6721959c1.jpg
The map screen will show the location of detected movement.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e9ec967f8b3e59e9163b4aebae4d02ab4a5fbfb0.jpg
Traps can now be baited and will lure monsters to them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/ca8cfb9f2e4bcedf0cd8652a388540649504d9ae.jpg
A mine and many new grenades have been added. Frag, Flame, Stun and Molotov.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/951e97f395cfd50ebe2b44b6a001a4c43e4474b8.jpg
The Minigun is an automatic turret that engages any non-human life it detects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/463cf58c4afc6c16c756077c078d310132d0ddc6.jpg
The Tactical Decoy is a state-of-the-art top secret device for luring any and all monsters.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/b573634161fc1fda0d4e2af90dfc3d5a5f805cfb.jpg
Night Vision is good for hunting in dark forests or pitch black interiors.

Furniture Customization
You can now customize different areas of the FOB in different themes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/a5cbe5099ff6c9c9fbbd0852c2a2d5d0e0b5cec2.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/408761d39221a969edb4a91dbddea0f053b25d59.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3be919e509b8b19a99804b8e9fb56a8472f0cf4d.jpg
These are only a handful of the available options. More areas can also be customized.

Body Camera
A new Body Camera has been added that enables a more immersive experience. 
It also includes a useful zoom feature when aiming while not holding a weapon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/aff1d8547a616db6f38845c77fc62c01b4fca397.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/14c4da7d3bfb5112c6b97e1038e5b89b933a5d3e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7d5b9a31360749a449c5064a6aabb69ee3393223.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/9e3c58ec8a15c27d2dd0c4c2e998be1534627c3d.jpg

notes.title: Update e1.16
notes.content:
This update is primarily a much needed quality of life improvement in many areas of the game. 
These new changes should improve some of the pain points players have been experiencing.

Quad Bike handling has been improved and is less prone to flipping
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/837915e7f3cf30a2a71d89b8b14c59446cd7b657.png

Recently used vehicles will now have a waypoint for easy tracking
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e7cd0a4badbe15f74ebcf4384d4424f3eeb20a91.png

The favorites bar is now horizontal across the bottom for better usability
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/812016629fcffa04f02dc820611323f47b153166.png

Plus many more smaller improvements!

Improvements:

 Decreased stamina cost of rolling
 Added invulnerability when rolling
 Removed snow from main menu
 Removed snow from FOB
 Removed Christmas decoration from FOB
 Quad Bikes are less prone to killing you in multiplayer
 Quad Bike handling has been improved (better steering and less flipping)
 Added waypoint for last used vehicle
 Improved tire skid effects on dirt
 Vehicle skid smoke no longer glows at night
 Monsters will flee if the player dodges the attacks multiple times in a row
 Weapons no longer get put away when using items from the favorites menu
 Favorites bar is now horizontal and at the bottom of the screen
 The shortcuts 1,2,3,4,5 on pc now close the favorites bar 


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed some screen effects that were being washed out
 Fixed issue where the game would crash upon loading the FOB or Cases




Content updates are in the works and will be coming soon™!

notes.title: Devlog #6 [June 2022]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to our sixth devlog.  Check it out! And thanks for reading!

Recent Progress

Sunnyside Expanded
Camp Sunnyside was expanded to include more facilities and environmental storytelling. Enjoy the new areas to checkout!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/c838f4248671acb1b7f7dc06a2e063a2b308de18.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3349bda87b70d5a31407ad714076aa3575ededd2.png

Session Parameters
Sessions can now be customized with different settings. Friendly fire, invite only and reviving settings.
You can also give the session a name of your choice.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/640558133881953c12ee573db6a6fe54566689bf.png

New Gun
We also added a new pistol! Pistols have very fast reloads compared to all other weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/2ca1d6b6f27a0cd8d9b3efcdd720adb2ad574f8c.png

New FOB Map Texture
We updated the FOB with it's own map in the tablet! Should make things easier to explore the area. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/a3c9b3e1bb663377e1a5435d43df7be1dcd026c1.png

Support for Invites
You can now send invites and join sessions from invites, granted you're not already in a session.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/69a58574af40d305d82b1dc806b8fb8e6f954685.png
You can find the invite button in the pause menu. (Steam overlay required)

Next Month's Focus
Some features listed won't necessarily be fully completed within' the month and could take up to several months to be finished or even functional. It's just what we're focusing on the most this time.

FOB Computer
Our next milestone is to get a working FOB computer so players can select cases and manage the FOB.

- A Day Out Crew

If you want to track the progress more closely, watch our Trello!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/0bcd986e58ee60b9c9a2612fa60c0ceb2fa2e5a4.png

notes.title: Devlog #5 [April 2022]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to our fifth devlog.  Check it out! And thanks for reading!

Recent Progress

Quad Bike
During these past few months we managed to get working vehicles! Now you don't have to waste time walking around the map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/d1e949c0fc5a0e65522072b098bf4027020cc4a5.png
 In future updates, the quad bike will be capable of receiving damage from crashing and attack from enemies. The wheels will fall off as damage is taken; Reducing overall speed and control.

Tablet Objectives
Finished the objectives menu for the tablet. You can also pin the current objective to the HUD for convenience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/49b01a437b4c0af0746fc0d8b28601afee4dc140.png

FOB (Forward Operating Base)
We spent a long time developing "The FOB" map. This map is essentially the main hideout for your team. All cases are launched from here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/29847ca9021b1609f04baa2200cb12236274030f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/563c7369c8299514817c873cad7ac8ec167083e7.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/4aa8a78dc92fb8b92f9f43be44c1752d65a253de.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/9e3ebdd93a0045393102d7fd34f71a7b6bcbee67.png

 New Guns
We also added two new additional guns. Providing long and short range respectively.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/8340723876728bbfc0a1d2d7ce487a1a14931a6e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/fcc3bbabf25cc7a7b6ffb18c3f35d1ef9c182bf3.png

Next Month's Focus
Some features listed won't necessarily be fully completed within' the month and could take up to several months to be finished or even functional. It's just what we're focusing on the most this time.

Multiplayer Demo
The free multiplayer demo is coming out in June, so stay tuned for more details soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/78e502e20687dfd26e64f96d8027ea367e658342.png
We're hard at work, finishing up the demo case.

- A Day Out Crew

notes.title: Devlog #3 [December 2021]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to our third devlog.  Check it out! And thanks for reading!

Recent Progress

Virtual Cursor
We created a Virtual Cursor that can be used to interact with screens in the world space. The Virtual Cursor can be controlled via gamepad with the left joystick. It was originally designed to be used for interacting with the new tablet, but later we'll expand on it and add more interactable screens like computers, televisions and touchscreens.

Interactable Tablet
The new Interactable Tablet will be the main interface used during every case in the game. It contains several 'apps' that enable access to different features. The tablet itself is in the world space, but always accessible on the player character.
(Similar to a certain wrist bound computer from a game with vaults)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6cd8e927e0e74f120cefe3055d03c334260f9db9.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/68fde3c248a199ce3cf615ee4d0426618d5db379.png

 Map: Interactable map with waypoints and landmarks
 Inventory: The player's inventory
 Objectives: The case objectives
 Devices: An interface used to remote control various items (camera, drone, etc.)
 Recordings: An interface to playback audio logs found in the world


Player Inventory:
The Player Inventory can be accessed via the Interactable Tablet. Use it to select your weapons and preview any item in your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3a5f745a546453c001e380667dfd1e7efca1cd99.png

Additionally, the inventory also shows the stats for a weapon upon hovering over it.

The Inventory has a feature for 'favoriting' your weapons and assigning them to a specific shortcut slot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/7727c2afc1ee4d946b2591643a7b4cb9df6dceac.png
(The circle icons are placeholders. Icons unique to each item will be added later)

New Snow Effect
We thought our old snow looked a little too dull, so we made it more interesting and dynamic. Snow will now deform when a player or monster walks over it, leaving a visible trail behind.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/e6b972038c04cd2c73c63738db879def8161ba3a.png

Next Month's Focus
Some features listed won't necessarily be fully completed within' the month and could take up to several months to be finished or even functional. It's just what we're focusing on the most this time.

Maps
 
 A new snow village map (using the new snow)
 The FOB (Forward operating base)
 

Tablet
 
 Finish Map screen
 Finish Objectives screen
 Finish Devices screen
 Finish Recordings screen
 

- A Day Out Crew

notes.title: Devlog #2 [November 2021]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to our second devlog. We've got some new UI systems to show off. Check it out!

Recent Progress

Widget Tree Framework:
We put in some extra effort to create our own little widget tree framework so controller bound players can quickly step back and forth between menus. This framework should allow us to create child and sub menus pretty easily for the whole game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/52d25428b591115cb5a78ae1b2053acc9981760f.png
This is an example of what a menu with submenus in the hierarchy could look like using this framework. It allows a user to step up and down the tree with the press of a button. (For a PS4 controller it would be Circle to go up and X to down)

Pause Menu:
A simple little pause menu. It's definitely not final, but it's functional and serves its purpose.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/75ce136daaf4ede8df1cb43dcb21a49de3943f18.png

Control Settings Menu:
We started making the control settings with controller rebinding support as well. It's also not final either. Still under development with many more settings in the works.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/1467ced3703d17bb17216afcdeab6aa4efb47f8e.png

Container Inventory Preview
When you hover over a container with items in it, a small preview of it's contents will be shown on screen. You can also grab the items straight from this menu. (If there's room in your inventory)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/f77c76a8a6972b258bead54e0af159c3e5e5036e.png
(Similar to a certain game containing vaults)

Next Month's Focus
Some features listed won't necessarily be fully completed within' the month and could take up to several months to be finished or even functional. It's just what we're focusing on the most this time.

Maps
 
 Swamp Map
 Player's Main Base (aka 'The FOB')
 Farm


User Interfaces

 Quick select and favorite weapon system
 Tablet interface (contains a map view, inventory management, remaining objectives)
 Animated health bar for currently targeted enemy


AI Improvements and Features

 Kidnap a player back to a location
 Can be Nocturnal
 Lay traps on the ground for players
 Lure players toward the Monster by sound or effects
 Ghost can use teleporting
 Monster can be baited with food or some item


- A Day Out Crew

notes.title: Devlog #1 [October 2021]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/6b47d6c09489e7546fe52844b0df01ac7f30b978.png

Welcome to the first devlog. We'll be showing off the current state of the game and revealing our future plans so you have a reason to get excited. So take a close look! 👀

Current Progress
Alright, let's see what we've got done already.

New Maps:
The maps in A Day Out are where you'll run into supernatural creatures, depending on the case you choose. Each map varies in size from small islands to large forests or deserts. The larger maps often have hidden or secluded locations to discover such as caves, cabins, bunkers, houses, factories and warehouses. Filled with loot of course.


 Camp Sunnyside
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/17b38d8aedb57d8ecf89a2c0a1c57096b86fa2bf.png
Death's Canyon
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/c07a113cbf314710fc2d53dd4c489e7b9f28aeef.png
Cold Storage
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/a6e9f6ec558dcc4639d08a593c60dca4341d1776.png
Wetlands

Asylum
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/29dd53595e07bbcadafebc06e7a786859e54bd37.png


Inspection System:
The inspection system allows players to interect with objects and read some info about it. You can also rotate and zoom the item in 3D to get a better look. This system will be useful for learning about items players should be aware of.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3d3ea3bd5163c5278722d69774fd0d9404b9975c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/3567dd2aea86d25304806623bb0eccf35aa50f55.png
Notes are a special item that display the text written on them.

Visual Case Scripting System:
Our custom made "Visual Case Scripting System" will enable designers to rapidly develop linear event driven cases for the game. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/cbe74014037ad2ac06cc9b720c91c788ffe8fca8.png
(It makes creating cases really easy so we can spend more time on designing the case as well as possible)

Game HUD:
Although the HUD is still under development, it's still functional in it's current state. The HUD currently has a compass for navigating, weapon status, stamina and health bars.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41373640/60ecfb704a82f49f5203ba392c0e865d79bab6d8.png

Future Plans
The good stuff. Let's get into it.

Disclaimer:
The order of the features listed is not necessarily the order these features will be completed.
Some features may not be ready for the Early Access release.
(In other words, no promises)

Monster Cases:

 A case featuring the Male Wendigo
 A case featuring the Giant Zombie Hound
 A case featuring the Mutated Slime Monster
 A case featuring the Female Wendigo
 A case featuring the Swamp Drowner
 A case featuring the Mutated Monstrosities


Paranormal Cases:

 A case featuring a haunted insane asylum on an island
 A case featuring a haunted mansion
 A case featuring a haunted suburban house


Extraterrestrial Cases:

 A case featuring "Visitors"
 A case featuring "tic-tacs"


Character Customization:

 Wardrobe options for male characters
 Wardrobe options for female characters
 Hats, Shirts, Pants, Shoes, Backpacks, accessories and etc.
 Facial appearance options


Weapons:

 Hunting Rifles

 Pistols
 Shotguns
 Submachine Guns
 Crossbows
 Throwables


Gear and Gadgets:

 Tablet (Includes map view)
 Deployable Cameras
 Paranormal Detection Devices
 Paranormal Defense Items
 Binoculars
 Deployable Traps


Vehicles:

 Quad Bike
 Dune Buggy


Singleplayer Demo:
Our next big focus is on creating a full case that will be shown off as a demo for the game. Once we finish the demo we'll have an even better understanding of how the gameplay will be. At some point this demo will also become available on the store page as a singleplayer experience.

- A Day Out Crew
